text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
A racing outfit. It is the special attire in which us 
Uma Musume pour our passion into the race.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
And it’s also a beautiful necessity on our path to the race. 
This fashion show is here to share the charm of these racing 
outfits anew—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Presenting the "TRACEN GIRLS COLLECTION", now open! 
I, North Flight, will be your host!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
A festival filled with Uma Musume showcasing their 
racing outfits, and the participants are all the stars of the 
Twinkle Series! I'll be covering this event in full detail!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Alright, to begin with I’ll try walking like a model! 
Walking like a model... ahh, can I really do this!?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, stop yapping already! As long as I walk 
in some way that looks right, we’ll be good!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Looks right"? Do you even realize how sick 
City’s walk is!? Seriously, it’s amazing! There’s 
no way I can pull off something like that.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: (It seems like everyone is rattled by this unusual situation. But—)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(I was asked to participate in such an 
important event. There’s no way I can fail now!)

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let's kick things off with the 
model walk and let them showcase their 
racing outfits! Starting with Duramente!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: (I will see this through. Elegantly, flawlessly—like a true model would!)

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Th-this is...! Duramente’s famous pre-race walk!!

text_block_list.name: 観客
text_block_list.text:
Woaahh! She did that when I saw her race 
before! Haha, she’s really fired up, huh?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
The monotone with gold hues bring out a 
sense of elegance, while the accent colors 
highlight her strength in this racing outfit!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: I messed up. I’ve failed Big Sis Groove’s expectations—)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Oh wowww! The crowd’s going crazy, huh!? 
Duramente’s got the audience hyped just by walking! That’s insane!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, thanks to her, we now know what 
to do. Instead of walking "like models"...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: We just need to walk like ourselves!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Whoooooooo!! Hey, you lot!! Burn my outfit into your eyes!!!

text_block_list.name: 舎弟たち
text_block_list.text: Yeeeeess!! Pockeeett!!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
The asymmetrical silhouette and the deliberately 
loose footwear create an effortless look, while...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
The wild use of colors and animal print accents 
make such a bold statement! It suits Pocket perfectly.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hah!? What the heck are you doing, Pocket?! 
Well, I guess it’s cool if the crowd’s into it...?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
So, that means... I just need to hype them up
in my own way! Alrighty then—here we go!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaahh!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Wow, what light and energetic movement! Her 
racing outfit combines a sporty aesthetic with 
functionality, and she’s showing it off really well!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I have no idea what’s going on anymore, but at this 
point, not going with the flow would just be uncool!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Everyone, check these nails out! Whooo! Whooo! Whooo!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Mesh, zippers, glitter, and aurora highlights... 
so many different materials mixed together, but 
it’s all tied into this wonderfully modern design!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
And most importantly, her nails match perfectly with 
her outfit! You can see the detail and passion, from 
her outfit all the way to the tips of her fingers!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
And that’s why they call you the Fashion 
Queen! You really know your stuff♪

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
This is truly an amazing event! It’s so different 
from the fashion shows I’ve seen before...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Racing outfits are designed to make the individuality of 
each Uma Musume shine in the most appealing way possible...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: So I think this lively, unique atmosphere suits the theme perfectly♪

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(She’s right. Everyone is expressing their 
individuality. But here I am, only failing...)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Stop making that face. What you did was also a part of your individuality.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You tend to get nervous and stiffen up. But what 
makes up for that is the fighting spirit and sincerity 
that shines through in your walk. That’s you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Both your fans and I admire you for your individuality, 
so hold your head up high. The show isn’t over yet.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Alright, Big Sis Groove!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
For the final shot, let's have you all pose with passion! 
Strike your best pose and share what your racing outfit truly means to you!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
To me, my racing outfit is like a partner chasing the same 
dream!! When I wear it, I get all excited and pumped up!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
To me, it’s my battle gear! It’s what I wear to go out and fight, 
and I’m gonna keep wearing it until I become the strongest!!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I personally designed this outfit, my nails, and everything 
else! So obviously it’s my favorite. It’s totally me, like my 
full-on passion put into clothing form, y’know?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
To me, this racing outfit is a symbol of pride. It had to be 
an outfit worthy of being called the strongest. That’s why...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: I based it on Big Sis Groove’s racing outfit.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I told you not to call me that in front of everyone... jeez.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, thank you so much for showing us such wonderful 
outfits and sharing your heartfelt thoughts! Hehe, now I’m 
excited to wear my own racing outfit and get out on the track too.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: When that day comes, please let me be the first to interview you!
